profile.bio:
I am a master’s student in mathematics at the University of Wisconsin–Madison. My research interests lie in algebraic combinatorics, with current work on algebraic graph theory and Lorentzian polynomials.

I received my B.S. in Mathematics from Shanghai Jiao Tong University in 2026.
